purpose: Prevent forward-engineering controls from being mistaken for contractual assessment evidence.

engineering_baseline.use: Forward engineering, architecture, and readiness-gap management.

cmmc_level_2.basis: 110 security requirements aligned to NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2 under 32 CFR part 170

cmmc_level_3.basis: CMMC Level 2 plus selected NIST SP 800-172 requirements under 32 CFR part 170

hard_rule: Do not use Rev. 3 engineering evidence to claim a CMMC Level 2 assessment result unless the governing CMMC framework is formally updated to that basis and the required assessment is completed.
